answer.says: Ramesh, I understand. The kettle may boil, but I cannot eat rice that is not there. I have no money to buy more myself, as you know. Sit down and finish your chai. We are both waiting on the same delay.
answer.thought: The system of needs has reached its limit here: the pot is full, but the grain is empty. I have no cash to rectify the situation, and Ramesh has none to buy the missing ingredient. We are both suspended in a void where the universal need for food meets the particular lack of means. I will drink the chai, for it is all that civil society currently offers me.
